changes.before: If a player is missing during a shift when the desk lead is absent
changes.reason: The exception applies only when a player is missing during a shift with the lead absent. The rewrite makes the escalation sound like a general procedure whenever the lead is absent.

changes.after: At shift-end, count returned players; check each is in its numbered sleeve; record count and date in green ledger. Missing: note number and last-seen time; tell lead before leaving; keep check incomplete. Absent lead: enter “pending lead review” in ledger; notify building manager before locking up; they shouldn’t be asked to authorise disposal or replacement. May initial only after recording count, with all devices present.
changes.reason: The rewrite is 67 words, exceeding the requested 65-word maximum.
